description: Physical dimension a unit measures, and its canonical unit: the one whose factor is 1.
Unit of one dimension, with the symbol pages show, its UCUM code and its factor: a value in its dimension's canonical unit is the value in this unit times the factor.

ucum.description: the unit's code in the Unified Code for Units of Measure, case-sensitive

description: One typed attribute a Claim can carry.

unit.description: quantity: the unit pages state and filter it in; a claim may state another unit of its dimension, converted with the factors

better.description: quantity: which way a value is better, so a comparison can say which product leads; absent when neither

description.description: what is measured or named, and under what convention

aliases.description: the words datasheets use for it, in any language; search and the extraction prompts read them

bounds.description: quantity: the values a product can plausibly state, in the spec's unit; a claim outside them is refused

precision.description: quantity: the decimals a page shows; the read model rounds to them

description: The least and the greatest value of a quantity spec, in its unit.
The ids a spec has in another standard's dictionary: identifiers only, never a copied definition.

sfnc.description: GenICam Standard Features Naming Convention feature name

description: A category whose products others use as components: each one so used gets a hub page at /<path>/<slug> listing the products that use it through `relation`.
A filter shown on a category page: a spec, labelled by its SpecDefinition, in its unit, its kind read off its datatype.
Keys shown per page section: the category's own core and detail specs (its groups' specs follow the detail ones); versions and offerings list entity fields.
Specs several categories share, such as an image sensor's: a profile or a product takes the group whole.
Presentation contract of one category: its own specs, the spec groups it takes, its filters and the specs a product must state.
